'''Marc Thompson''' is an American voice actor for the English [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}. He is currently affiliated with Innovative Artists.

==Biography==
Thompson was born on May 20, 1975, in Webster, New York. In 1997, he graduated from the Tisch School at New York University and pursued a voice acting career afterwards. Thompson began voicing characters in the {{pkmn|animated series}} in the middle of {{aniseries|GS}}. He provided many minor and additional voices until [[4Kids Entertainment]] [[Pokémon USA recasting controversy|gave up the dubbing and distribution of the series]] to {{TPCi|Pokémon USA}} and [[TAJ Productions]].

Thompson returned to {{aniseries|PTS}} in ''[[DP060|Journey to the Unown!]]'', where he provided the voice of [[Saturn]]. In {{aniseries|BW}}, he gained many important roles in the series, particularly those of [[Don George]], the [[Unova]] [[Pokédex]], [[Ash's Pignite]] and {{AP|Krookodile}}, and [[Dr. Zager]]. In {{aniseries|XY}}, he voiced [[Remo]], as well as [[Ash's Noibat]] and {{AP|Noivern}}. His roster of major roles expanded even further during {{aniseries|SM}}, where he gained the roles of [[Samson Oak]] and [[Kiawe's Turtonator]]. Besides doing voice-over work, Thompson is a minister in the International Churches of Christ - New York Chapter.
